headerDisplay: Controls a Visonic PowerMaster panel through the same PowerManage account used by the Visonic-Go app. Home sets Home mode, Away sets Away mode, and Off disarms the panel.

host.title: PowerManage host
host.description: Hostname from the Visonic-Go server, without https://. Use your alarm company's host if it is not visonic.tycomonitor.com.

panelSerial.title: Panel serial
panelSerial.description: The panel web name or serial shown for this system in Visonic-Go.

userCode.title: Master user code
userCode.description: The master code used to arm and disarm the panel.

appId.title: App id
appId.description: A stable UUID for this Homebridge install. Leave blank to generate one on first launch.

partition.title: Partition
partition.description: Use -1 for the whole panel, or a partition number such as 1.

nightArm.title: Night mode
nightArm.description: Visonic has no separate night state. HomeKit Night uses this mode.
